grouping: Expectation and tone mismatch

Let a reassuring claim, familiar voice or normal setup collide with an incongruous image or ending. These remain distinct submechanisms: self-image contradiction, delayed reversal, speaker reveal and deadpan shock.
Reframing identity or value
Borrow a label or judgment from another domain to change how an ordinary role, age, preference or behavior feels. Preserve the particular mapping; these are not interchangeable slogans.
Double meaning and literalization
Activate two readings through image, homophone, word split or alternate expansion. Some need visible action; others need insider vocabulary.
Everyday activity as grand action
Elevate minor discomfort, routine work, hobby or pet resistance using heroic or ceremonial language and imagery.
Borrowed formats
Move an award, warning, review, certificate, package or advertisement into an unexpected subject. Format recognition does much of the work.
Human roles and animal traits
Make an animal or cryptid act as an emotional proxy or take on an incongruous human role. In the drummer, unusual anatomy supplies a task advantage.
Visual recombination and consequences
Build a scene where a familiar trait, object shape or abstract phrase produces a surprising physical relationship.
Implied explanation or counterfactual
Ask the viewer to supply a missing explanation, imagined alternative or comic cause. The interpretation must not become a factual claim.
Grammar escalation
Intensify a familiar refusal by breaking expected comparative grammar.
Seasonal phrase relocation
Transfer a familiar festive frame to another ritual bundle.
Poetic accumulation
Use a repeated list to expand from practical examples to imaginative or impossible ones.
